name: Dew
overview: Scripture presents dew as a tangible sign of God's merciful providence, often forming imperceptibly during the night and described as the 'dew of heaven' (Deuteronomy 33:13). The account of Gideon’s fleece (Judges 6:36-40) illustrates dew’s miraculous profusion and selective presence, demonstrating God's sovereign control over nature to confirm His promises and reassure His people. This phenomenon highlights both the physical and figurative significance of dew as an expression of divine blessing and guidance.
